objective: Verify one four-A100 output-coupled identity-gate update preserves exact projected-only output under zero recurrent correction and has finite active gradients.

authorization_precondition.required_cross_fit_result: A separately signed donor-disjoint open-fit cross-fit result must pass its preregistered learned identity margin and carrier-invariance gates.

architecture.carrier_rule: The projected carrier is retained by reference and is not an identity-head input to the output residual.
architecture.zero_rule: With explicitly zero recurrent correction, output logits must byte-match the explicit projected-only bypass.
architecture.trainable_parameters: 42 layers x 4 bilinear rank-4 tensors = 168 FP32 tensors / 21,504 elements; optional query projector is excluded unless cross-fit protocol explicitly selects it.

training.open_rows_only: Four already-open fit rows, one per rank
